# BuzzVideo

> BuzzVideo is an AI ad generator for marketers and creators. Its Marketing Agent turns a product photo, link or idea into campaign-ready video and image ads, using leading models such as Seedance, Kling, Nano Banana and GPT Image in one place.

New accounts get 500 free credits, usable on Seedream 4.5, Seedream 5.0 lite, Seed Audio 1.0 and the image upscaler; video generation needs a Starter, Pro or Ultra plan. Work made on the Free plan carries a watermark; paid plans remove it. Everything you generate can be used commercially. BuzzVideo MCP (https://mcp.buzzvideo.ai/mcp) lets ChatGPT, Claude and other MCP clients generate videos, images and audio on a BuzzVideo account.

## Ads and agent tools

- [AI Ad Generator: Video & Image Ads](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-ad-generator): AI ad generator that turns a product photo, link or brief into video and image ads for TikTok, Reels and Meta, in every size, with new variations on request.
- [URL to Video: Product Page to Video Ad](https://buzzvideo.ai/url-to-video): URL to video: paste a product page, landing page or doc link and get a vertical video ad with a hook, selling points and a call to action, made with Wan 3.0.
- [AI UGC Video Generator & UGC Creator for Ads](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-ugc-video-generator): AI UGC video generator for ads: a real-looking creator talks about your product from one photo. Up to 30-second single takes with Kling 4.0 on BuzzVideo.
- [AI Product Video Generator from One Photo](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-product-video-generator): AI product video generator: make unboxings, demos and hero shots from one product photo, with the label kept the same. Seedance, Kling and Wan on BuzzVideo.
- [AI Marketing Agent: Brief In, Ads Out](https://buzzvideo.ai/marketing-agent): AI marketing agent you brief in plain words: BuzzVideo plans the strategy, writes the ad copy and makes video and image ads in one chat.

## Video tools

- [AI Video Generator: Seedance, Kling & Wan](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-video-generator): AI video generator with Seedance 2.5, Kling 4.0, Wan 3.0 and MiniMax H3 in one account. Make videos from text or an image, with audio, for YouTube and TikTok.
- [Text to Video AI: Prompt to Video Clip](https://buzzvideo.ai/text-to-video): Text to video AI: write a prompt and get a clip with motion and native sound, up to 30 seconds in one take, from Seedance 2.5, Kling 4.0 or Wan 3.0.
- [Image to Video AI: Turn Any Photo into Video](https://buzzvideo.ai/image-to-video): Image to video AI that uses your photo as the first frame, so the product or person stays the same. Animate stills up to 30 seconds with Seedance or Kling.
- [AI Video Editor Online: Edit Video with a Prompt](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-video-editor): AI video editor online: change a clip with one text prompt. Swap the background, an outfit or an object while motion and timing stay. Seedance 2.5.
- [Faceless Video Generator with Voiceover](https://buzzvideo.ai/faceless-video-generator): Faceless video generator: give one topic and get a video with AI voiceover, generated visuals and captions for Shorts, TikTok and Reels, no one on camera.
- [AI Caption Generator for Video Ads](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-caption-generator): AI caption generator for video ads: subtitles synced to each voiceover line in Hybrid Reel, styled for TikTok and Instagram Reels, in 9:16, 1:1 or 16:9.
- [AI B-roll Generator: Cutaway Clips](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-b-roll-generator): AI B-roll generator: make cutaway clips from a prompt or reference image for UGC ads and faceless videos, up to 30 seconds, with Seedance, Kling and Wan.
- [AI Short Drama Generator: Vertical Series](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-short-drama): AI short drama generator: turn a one-line premise into vertical micro-drama episodes with a consistent cast, storyboards, dialogue and cliffhangers.
- [AI Animation Generator from Image or Text](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-animation-generator): AI animation generator from image or text: make 3D cartoon, 2D hand-drawn, claymation or paper cut-out clips online, up to 30 seconds per take.
- [AI Anime Generator: Anime Videos & Art](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-anime-generator): AI anime generator: create anime-style clips and stills from a prompt, or restyle a photo as an anime character and animate it with Seedance, Kling and Wan.
- [AI Dance Video Generator from a Photo](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-dance-video): AI dance video generator: upload a photo and a dance video, and BuzzVideo copies the moves onto your character, up to 30 seconds, with Kling 3.0 Motion Control.
- [AI Video Extender Online: Make Clips Longer](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-video-extender): AI video extender online: continue a clip in the same scene and style. Extend forward or backward with Seedance 2.5, or add 15 seconds a run with MiniMax.
- [AI Camera Control: Choose Camera Moves](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-camera-control): AI camera control: turn one image into a video with 13 camera moves, like dolly in, pan, tilt and roll, while the scene stays still. MiniMax H3 Max.
- [Long Video to Shorts AI with Captions](https://buzzvideo.ai/long-video-to-shorts): Long video to shorts: turn a livestream, webinar or podcast into 9:16 clips with captions and hook titles via the Long to Shorts skill in ChatGPT or Claude.
- [AI Dubbing: Translate Video Voice](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-dubbing): AI dubbing for video: voice a translated script with Seed Audio 1.0 or MiniMax Speech 2.8 HD, then match the speaker's lips to the new audio with AI Lip Sync.
- [AI Music Video Generator from Audio or Lyrics](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-music-video-generator): AI music video generator from audio or lyrics: add your own song or make one with Lyria 3.5 or ElevenLabs Music, then generate scenes with Seedance 2.5.
- [Motion Control AI: Transfer Motion to a Photo](https://buzzvideo.ai/motion-control): Motion control AI video: copy the moves from a 2 to 30 second clip onto a character in one photo with Kling 3.0 Motion Control, and keep the original sound.
- [3D to Video AI: Render Blockouts as Real Shots](https://buzzvideo.ai/3d-to-video): 3D to video: render a Blender, Unreal, Cinema 4D or Maya blockout as a realistic video that keeps your camera moves and timing, up to 15 seconds and 1080p.
- [AI Video Upscaler: Upscale Video to 4K Online](https://buzzvideo.ai/upscale-video): AI video upscaler online: enlarge a clip up to 10x or to 4K. SeedVR rebuilds detail frame by frame, and you export MP4, WEBM, MOV or GIF on BuzzVideo.
- [AI Canvas: Images, Video & Audio on One Board](https://buzzvideo.ai/canvas): BuzzVideo AI Canvas puts images, video and audio on one board as connected nodes. Use each shot as the next one's reference, or start from a template.
- [Claude Video Generator: Make Videos in Claude](https://buzzvideo.ai/claude-video-generator): Claude video generator: Claude can't make realistic video on its own. Connect BuzzVideo MCP and it calls Seedance 2.5, Kling 4.0 and Wan 3.0 in the chat.
- [ChatGPT Video Generator: Make Ads in ChatGPT](https://buzzvideo.ai/chatgpt-video-generator): ChatGPT video generator: add BuzzVideo to ChatGPT, mention @BuzzVideo and describe your ad. BuzzVideo MCP makes the video and returns it to the chat.
- [Video Generation MCP Server for Claude & ChatGPT](https://buzzvideo.ai/video-generation-mcp): Video generation MCP server for Claude, ChatGPT and other MCP clients: one URL lets your AI chat make video, images and audio on BuzzVideo's models.
- [AI Face Swap for Video & Photos Online](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-face-swap): AI face swap for video and photos: replace the people in a 5 to 30 second clip with characters from your photos, or swap a face in a picture. Up to 1080p.
- [Video Face Swap AI: Replace People Online](https://buzzvideo.ai/video-face-swap): Video face swap AI online: replace up to four people in a 5 to 30 second clip with characters from your photos, keeping every move and camera angle, at 1080p.
- [AI Script to Video Generator with Voiceover](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-script-to-video): AI script to video generator: paste a script; the Marketing Agent splits it into scenes, adds visuals, voiceover and captions, and edits a 9:16 or 16:9 video.

## Avatar and lip sync tools

- [AI Spokesperson Video Generator](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-spokesperson): AI spokesperson video generator: a presenter or a talking product introduces what you sell from a product photo and a script, in a natural voice.
- [AI Avatar Generator: Talking Video from a Photo](https://buzzvideo.ai/talking-avatar): AI avatar video generator: turn one photo and a voice track into a talking video with natural lip sync. Kling AI Avatar v2 Pro or MiniMax H3 Max, up to 15 min.
- [AI Lip Sync Video Generator](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-lip-sync): AI lip sync video generator: make a person in a video say new lines from audio or a typed script. Kling LipSync for clips, MiniMax H3 Max up to 15 minutes.
- [AI Influencer Generator for Brand Content](https://buzzvideo.ai/ai-influencer-generator): AI influencer generator: design a virtual creator with the same face in every post, then make UGC-style videos of them for Instagram, TikTok and ads.
